review.decision: Require positive proof before automatic retry and exercise rotation identity drift
review.notes: Fake time and transport, isolated HOME, no service restart or live tmux/socket. Actual receiver acknowledgement is weaker than an independent new-turn or delivery event.

cases.description: Positively refused transient input gets a durable bounded retry
cases.setup: Use a fake clock and native driver. Return explicit not-submitted transport evidence twice, then hit the refusal budget; include a terminal ambiguous response and stale/mismatched identity.
cases.action: Drain repeatedly before and after each backoff deadline, reconstruct the drainer over the same disk state, and count submissions for the same generation.
cases.expected: The generation ID stays stable while only a positively unsent attempt can use a fresh transport-attempt ID. No early dispatch, at most three known-unsent attempts, final exhaustion is retained and visible. Unknown and identity failures never submit again.

cases.description: A legacy wake with uncertain submission is retained without repaste
cases.setup: Synthetic HOME and fake legacy pane spanning an initially clean composer, a real or concurrently added draft, copy mode, unreadable and unknown identity. Model a missing acknowledgement, a late exact receipt, and restart after a mutation boundary.
cases.action: Drain, supply exact proof or ambiguous state, then drain again with independent pending work.
cases.expected: The uncertain original is never pasted twice. An exact matching receipt can settle without typing. Safe Enter-only behavior is limited to a positively matching own draft, with bounded retries and recheck. Real drafts, unready or unidentifiable targets receive no input.

cases.description: A changed rotation successor ends in an independent failure without another reset
cases.setup: An exact fake HQ target with a sent reservation and two successive differing successor IDs across quota/turn-boundary checks.
cases.action: Advance the first observed successor, then supply the second and replay the old request predicate.
cases.expected: A receiver/start observation does not confirm durable handoff. Changed successor is reported independently, one reset at most, stale retry is inert.
